description: This file defines command schemas, parsing functions, and related types for CLI commands in the Playwright project, including command declaration and argument parsing logic.

methods.name: declareCommand
methods.description: Declares and returns a command schema, possibly for registration or export.

methods.name: parseCommand
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments according to a command schema, returning the tool name and parameters.

methods.name: zodParse
methods.description: Helper function to parse data with a Zod schema, providing detailed error messages.
